In our case, this is a good thing, since if this dictionary were"}, {"line": 174, "text": "picklable, it could lead to an excessively large pickle size for our value"}, {"line": 175, "text": "objects that are pickled by themselves outside of the context of the parent."}, {"line": 176, "text": "The developer responsibility here is only to provide a ``__getstate__`` method"}, {"line": 177, "text": "that excludes the :meth:`~MutableBase._parents` collection from the pickle"}, {"line": 178, "text": "stream::"}, {"line": 179, "text": ""}, {"line": 180, "text": "    class MyMutableType(Mutable):"}, {"line": 181, "text": "        def __getstate__(self):"}, {"line": 182, "text": "            d = self.__dict__.copy()"}, {"line": 183, "text": "            d.pop('_parents', None)"}, {"line": 184, "text": "            return d"}, {"line": 185, "text": ""}, {"line": 186, "text": "With our dictionary example, we need to return the contents of the dict itself"}, {"line": 187, "text": "(and also restore them on __setstate__)::"}, {"line": 188, "text": ""}, {"line": 189, "text": "    class MutableDict(Mutable, dict):"}, {"line": 190, "text": "        # ...."}, {"line": 191, "text": ""}, {"line": 192, "text": "        def __getstate__(self):"}, {"line": 193, "text": "            return dict(self)"}, {"line": 194, "text": ""}, {"line": 195, "text": "        def __setstate__(self, state):"}, {"line": 196, "text": "            self.update(state)"}, {"line": 197, "text": ""}, {"line": 198, "text": "In the case that our mutable value object is pickled as it is attached to one"}, {"line": 199, "text": "or more parent objects that are also part of the pickle, the :class:`.Mutable`"}, {"line": 200, "text": "mixin will re-establish the :attr:`.Mutable._parents` collection on each value"}, {"line": 201, "text": "object as the owning parents themselves are unpickled."}, {"line": 202, "text": ""}, {"line": 203, "text": "Receiving Events"}, {"line": 204, "text": "----------------"}, {"line": 205, "text": ""}, {"line": 206, "text": "The :meth:`.AttributeEvents.modified` event handler may be used to receive"}, {"line": 207, "text": "an event when a mutable scalar emits a change event.  This event handler"}, {"line": 208, "text": "is called when the :func:`.attributes.flag_modified` function is called"}, {"line": 209, "text": "from within the mutable extension::"}, {"line": 210, "text": ""}, {"line": 211, "text": "    from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base"}, {"line": 212, "text": "    from sqlalchemy import event"}, {"line": 213, "text": ""}, {"line": 214, "text": "    Base = declarative_base()"}, {"line": 215, "text": ""}, {"line": 216, "text": "    class MyDataClass(Base):"}, {"line": 217, "text": "        __tablename__ = 'my_data'"}, {"line": 218, "text": "        id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)"}, {"line": 219, "text": "        data = Column(MutableDict.as_mutable(JSONEncodedDict))"}, {"line": 220, "text": ""}, {"line": 221, "text": "    @event.listens_for(MyDataClass.data, \"modified\")"}, {"line": 222, "text": "    def modified_json(instance):"}, {"line": 223, "text": "        print(\"json value modified:\", instance.data)"}, {"line": 224, "text": ""}, {"line": 225, "text": ".. _mutable_composites:"}, {"line": 226, "text": ""}, {"line": 227, "text": "Establishing Mutability on Composites"}, {"line": 228, "text": "====================================="}, {"line": 229, "text": ""}, {"line": 230, "text": "Composites are a special ORM feature which allow a single scalar attribute to"}, {"line": 231, "text": "be assigned an object value which represents information \"composed\" from one"}, {"line": 232, "text": "or more columns from the underlying mapped table. The usual example is that of"}, {"line": 233, "text": "a geometric \"point\", and is introduced in :ref:`mapper_composite`."}, {"line": 234, "text": ""}, {"line": 235, "text": "As is the case with :class:`.Mutable`, the user-defined composite class"}, {"line": 236, "text": "subclasses :class:`.MutableComposite` as a mixin, and detects and delivers"}, {"line": 237, "text": "change events to its parents via the :meth:`.MutableComposite.changed` method."}, {"line": 238, "text": "In the case of a composite class, the detection is usually via the usage of"}, {"line": 239, "text": "Python descriptors (i.e. ``@property``), or alternatively via the special"}, {"line": 240, "text": "Python method ``__setattr__()``. Below we expand upon the ``Point`` class"}, {"line": 241, "text": "introduced in :ref:`mapper_composite` to subclass :class:`.MutableComposite`"}, {"line": 242, "text": "and to also route attribute set events via ``__setattr__`` to the"}, {"line": 243, "text": ":meth:`.MutableComposite.changed` method::"}, {"line": 244, "text": ""}, {"line": 245, "text": "    from sqlalchemy.ext.mutable import MutableComposite"}, {"line": 246, "text": ""}, {"line": 247, "text": "    class Point(MutableComposite):"}, {"line": 248, "text": "        def __init__(self, x, y):"}, {"line": 249, "text": "            self.x = x"}, {"line": 250, "text": "            self.y = y"}, {"line": 251, "text": ""}, {"line": 252, "text": "        def __setattr__(self, key, value):"}, {"line": 253, "text": "            \"Intercept set events\""}, {"line": 254, "text": ""}, {"line": 255, "text": "            # set the attribute"}, {"line": 256, "text": "            object.__setattr__(self, key, value)"}, {"line": 257, "text": ""}, {"line": 258, "text": "            # alert all parents to the change"}, {"line": 259, "text": "            self.changed()"}, {"line": 260, "text": ""}, {"line": 261, "text": "        def __composite_values__(self):"}, {"line": 262, "text": "            return self.x, self.y"}, {"line": 263, "text": ""}, {"line": 264, "text": "        def __eq__(self, other):"}, {"line": 265, "text": "            return isinstance(other, Point) and \\"}, {"line": 266, "text": "                other.x == self.x and \\"}, {"line": 267, "text": "                other.y == self.y"}, {"line": 268, "text": ""}, {"line": 269, "text": "        def __ne__(self, other):"}, {"line": 270, "text": "            return not self.__eq__(other)"}, {"line": 271, "text": ""}, {"line": 272, "text": "The :class:`.MutableComposite` class uses a Python metaclass to automatically"}, {"line": 273, "text": "establish listeners for any usage of :func:`_orm.composite` that specifies our"}, {"line": 274, "text": "``Point`` type. Below, when ``Point`` is mapped to the ``Vertex`` class,"}, {"line": 275, "text": "listeners are established which will route change events from ``Point``"}, {"line": 276, "text": "objects to each of the ``Vertex.start`` and ``Vertex.end`` attributes::"}, {"line": 277, "text": ""}, {"line": 278, "text": "    from sqlalchemy.orm import composite, mapper"}, {"line": 279, "text": "    from sqlalchemy import Table, Column"}, {"line": 280, "text": ""}, {"line": 281, "text": "    vertices = Table('vertices', metadata,"}, {"line": 282, "text": "        Column('id', Integer, primary_key=True),"}, {"line": 283, "text": "        Column('x1', Integer),"}, {"line": 284, "text": "        Column('y1', Integer),"}, {"line": 285, "text": "        Column('x2', Integer),"}, {"line": 286, "text": "        Column('y2', Integer),"}, {"line": 287, "text": "        )"}, {"line": 288, "text": ""}, {"line": 289, "text": "    class Vertex(object):"}, {"line": 290, "text": "        pass"}, {"line": 291, "text": ""}, {"line": 292, "text": "    mapper(Vertex, vertices, properties={"}, {"line": 293, "text": "        'start': composite(Point, vertices.c.x1, vertices.c.y1),"}, {"line": 294, "text": "        'end': composite(Point, vertices.c.x2, vertices.c.y2)"}, {"line": 295, "text": "    })"}, {"line": 296, "text": ""}, {"line": 297, "text": "Any in-place changes to the ``Vertex.start`` or ``Vertex.end`` members"}, {"line": 298, "text": "will flag the attribute as \"dirty\" on the parent object::"}, {"line": 299, "text": ""}, {"line": 300, "text": "    >>> from sqlalchemy.orm import Session"}, {"line": 301, "text": ""}, {"line": 302, "text": "    >>> sess = Session()"}, {"line": 303, "text": "    >>> v1 = Vertex(start=Point(3, 4), end=Point(12, 15))"}, {"line": 304, "text": "    >>> sess.add(v1)"}, {"line": 305, "text": "    >>> sess.commit()"}, {"line": 306, "text": ""}, {"line": 307, "text": "    >>> v1.end.x = 8"}, {"line": 308, "text": "    >>> assert v1 in sess.dirty"}, {"line": 309, "text": "    True"}, {"line": 310, "text": ""}, {"line": 311, "text": "Coercing Mutable Composites"}, {"line": 312, "text": "---------------------------"}, {"line": 313, "text": ""}, {"line": 314, "text": "The :meth:`.MutableBase.coerce` method is also supported on composite types."}, {"line": 315, "text": "In the case of :class:`.MutableComposite`, the method is essentially equivalent"}, {"line": 318, "text": "to using a :func:`.validates` validation routine for all attributes which"}, {"line": 319, "text": "make use of the custom composite ..."}, {"line": 345, "text": ""}, {"line": 346, "text": "        def __getstate__(self):"}, {"line": 347, "text": "            return self.x, self.y"}, {"line": 348, "text": ""}, {"line": 349, "text": "        def __setstate__(self, state):"}, {"line": 350, "text": "            self.x, self.y = state"}, {"line": 351, "text": ""}, {"line": 352, "text": "As with :class:`.Mutable`, the :class:`.MutableComposite` augments the"}, {"line": 353, "text": "pickling process of the parent's object-relational state so that the"}, {"line": 354, "text": ":meth:`MutableBase._parents` collection is restored to all ``Point`` objects."}, {"line": 355, "text": ""}, {"line": 356, "text": "\"\"\""}, {"line": 357, "text": "from collections import defaultdict"}, {"line": 358, "text": "import weakref"}, {"line": 359, "text": ""}, {"line": 360, "text": "from .. import event"}, {"line": 361, "text": "from .. import inspect"}, {"line": 362, "text": "from .. import types"}, {"line": 363, "text": "from ..orm import Mapper"}, {"line": 364, "text": "from ..orm import mapper"}, {"line": 365, "text": "from ..orm.attributes import flag_modified"}, {"line": 366, "text": "from ..sql.base import SchemaEventTarget"}, {"line": 367, "text": "from ..util import memoized_property"}, {"line": 368, "text": ""}, {"line": 369, "text": ""}, {"line": 370, "text": "class MutableBase(object):"}, {"line": 371, "text": "    \"\"\"Common base class to :class:`.Mutable`"}, {"line": 372, "text": "    and :class:`.MutableComposite`."}, {"line": 373, "text": ""}, {"line": 374, "text": "    \"\"\""}, {"line": 375, "text": ""}, {"line": 376, "text": "    @memoized_property"}, {"line": 377, "text": "    def _parents(self):"}, {"line": 378, "text": "        \"\"\"Dictionary of parent object's :class:`.InstanceState`->attribute"}, {"line": 379, "text": "        name on the parent."}, {"line": 380, "text": ""}, {"line": 381, "text": "        This attribute is a so-called \"memoized\" property.  It initializes"}, {"line": 382, "text": "        itself with a new ``weakref.WeakKeyDictionary`` the first time"}, {"line": 383, "text": "        it is accessed, returning the same object upon subsequent access."}, {"line": 384, "text": ""}, {"line": 385, "text": "        .. versionchanged:: 1.4 the :class:`.InstanceState` is now used"}, {"line": 386, "text": "           as the key in the weak dictionary rather than the instance"}, {"line": 387, "text": "           itself."}, {"line": 388, "text": ""}, {"line": 389, "text": "        \"\"\""}, {"line": 390, "text": ""}, {"line": 391, "text": "        return weakref.WeakKeyDictionary()"}, {"line": 392, "text": ""}, {"line": 393, "text": "    @classmethod"}, {"line": 394, "text": "    def coerce(cls, key, value):"}, {"line": 395, "text": "        \"\"\"Given a value, coerce it into the target type."}, {"line": 396, "text": ""}, {"line": 397, "text": "        Can be overridden by custom subclasses to coerce incoming"}, {"line": 398, "text": "        data into a particular type."}, {"line": 399, "text": ""}, {"line": 400, "text": "        By default, raises ``ValueError``."}, {"line": 401, "text": ""}, {"line": 402, "text": "        This method is called in different scenarios depending on if"}, {"line": 403, "text": "        the parent class is of type :class:`.Mutable` or of type"}, {"line": 404, "text": "        :class:`.MutableComposite`.  In the case of the former, it is called"}, {"line": 405, "text": "        for both attribute-set operations as well as during ORM loading"}, {"line": 406, "text": "        operations.  For the latter, it is only called during attribute-set"}, {"line": 407, "text": "        operations; the mechanics of the :func:`.composite` construct"}, {"line": 408, "text": "        handle coercion during load operations."}, {"line": 409, "text": ""}, {"line": 410, "text": ""}, {"line": 411, "text": "        :param key: string name of the ORM-mapped attribute being set."}, {"line": 412, "text": "        :param value: the incoming value."}, {"line": 413, "text": "        :return: the method should return the coerced value, or raise"}, {"line": 414, "text": "         ``ValueError`` if the coercion cannot be completed."}, {"line": 415, "text": ""}, {"line": 416, "text": "        \"\"\""}, {"line": 417, "text": "        if value is None:"}, {"line": 418, "text": "            return None"}, {"line": 419, "text": "        msg = \"Attribute '%s' does not accept objects of type %s\""}, {"line": 420, "text": "        raise ValueError(msg % (key, type(value)))"}, {"line": 421, "text": ""}, {"line": 422, "text": "    @classmethod"}, {"line": 423, "text": "    def _get_listen_keys(cls, attribute):"}, {"line": 424, "text": "        \"\"\"Given a descriptor attribute, return a ``set()`` of the attribute"}, {"line": 425, "text": "        keys which indicate a change in the state of this attribute."}, {"line": 426, "text": ""}, {"line": 427, "text": "        This is normally just ``set([attribute.key])``, but can be overridden"}, {"line": 428, "text": "        to provide for additional keys.  E.g. a :class:`.MutableComposite`"}, {"line": 429, "text": "        augments this set with the attribute keys associated with the columns"}, {"line": 430, "text": "        that comprise the composite value."}, {"line": 431, "text": ""}, {"line": 432, "text": "        This collection is consulted in the case of intercepting the"}, {"line": 433, "text": "        :meth:`.InstanceEvents.refresh` and"}, {"line": 434, "text": "        :meth:`.InstanceEvents.refresh_flush` events, which pass along a list"}, {"line": 435, "text": "        of attribute names that have been refreshed; the list is compared"}, {"line": 436, "text": "        against this set to determine if action needs to be taken."}, {"line": 437, "text": ""}, {"line": 438, "text": "        .. versionadded:: 1.0.5"}, {"line": 439, "text": ""}, {"line": 440, "text": "        \"\"\""}, {"line": 441, "text": "        return {attribute.key}"}, {"line": 442, "text": ""}, {"line": 443, "text": "    @classmethod"}, {"line": 444, "text": "    def _listen_on_attribute(cls, attribute, coerce, parent_cls):"}, {"line": 445, "text": "        \"\"\"Establish this type as a mutation listener for the given"}, {"line": 446, "text": "        mapped descriptor."}, {"line": 447, "text": ""}, {"line": 448, "text": "        \"\"\""}, {"line": 449, "text": "        key = attribute.key"}, {"line": 450, "text": "        if parent_cls is not attribute.class_:"}, {"line": 451, "text": "            return"}, {"line": 452, "text": ""}, {"line": 453, "text": "        # rely on \"propagate\" here"}, {"line": 454, "text": "        parent_cls = attribute.class_"}, {"line": 455, "text": ""}, {"line": 456, "text": "        listen_keys = cls._get_listen_keys(attribute)"}, {"line": 457, "text": ""}, {"line": 458, "text": "        def load(state, *args):"}, {"line": 459, "text": "            \"\"\"Listen for objects loaded or refreshed."}, {"line": 460, "text": ""}, {"line": 461, "text": "            Wrap the target data member's value with"}, {"line": 462, "text": "            ``Mutable``."}, {"line": 463, "text": ""}, {"line": 464, "text": "            \"\"\""}, {"line": 465, "text": "            val = state.dict.get(key, None)"}, {"line": 466, "text": "            if val is not None:"}, {"line": 467, "text": "                if coerce:"}, {"line": 468, "text": "                    val = cls.coerce(key, val)"}, {"line": 469, "text": "                    state.dict[key] = val"}, {"line": 470, "text": "                val._parents[state] = key"}, {"line": 471, "text": ""}, {"line": 472, "text": "        def load_attrs(state, ctx, attrs):"}, {"line": 473, "text": "            if not attrs or listen_keys.intersection(attrs):"}, {"line": 474, "text": "                load(state)"}, {"line": 475, "text": ""}, {"line": 476, "text": "        def set_(target, value, oldvalue, initiator):"}, {"line": 477, "text": "            \"\"\"Listen for set/replace events on the target"}, {"line": 478, "text": "            data member."}, {"line": 479, "text": ""}, {"line": 480, "text": "            Establish a weak reference to the parent object"}], "source_version": "b1421c9fd59154e063ac0d0a98dd2370cdb225043de93162d8691361fca728b2"}

function.name: read_source
function.description: Read source lines from the candidate. Includes source_version, a SHA-256 of the complete normalized UTF-8 text.

function.name: search_source
function.description: Literal source search, up to 16 matches.

function.name: source_symbols
function.description: Find source definitions by optional name substring, with line spans. Useful for generated reader factories.

function.name: historical_cases
function.description: Describe the public historical data examples and their producer versions.

function.name: historical_artifact
function.description: Inspect a PUBLIC example's exact pickle opcode/state structure without loading it. Hidden inputs are unavailable.

function.name: apply_edits
function.description: Atomically apply exact text replacements. Only task-authorized source and tests/test_regression.py may change. Empty old text creates a NEW file only.

function.name: run_checks
function.description: Actually execute public checks inside a 1-CPU,1GB,no-network container. current checks current behavior; legacy checks historical examples and current behavior. Hidden inputs are not accessible.

function.name: read_historical_source
function.description: Read immutable producer-version source, not a fixed reader. Same line limits as read_source.

function.name: search_historical_source
function.description: Literal search of immutable old producer source, up to16matches.

function.name: list_sources
function.description: List up to200 source paths; optional prefix or substring query, with total match count.
